---
title: "Apprentissage ojs avec tidytuesday"
format: dashboard
engine: knitr
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
health_spending = FileAttachment('data/health_spending.csv')
  .csv({ typed: true })

countries = Array.from(
  new Set(health_spending.map(d => d.country_name))
).sort()

types_unit = [
  {name: "% of current health expenditure", location: "En proportion de la dépense de santé totale"},
  {name: "constant 2023 US$", location: "En dollars constants de 2023"},
]

```

# {.sidebar}

```{ojs}

viewof selected_country = Inputs.select(
  countries,
  {
    label: "Choisir un pays :",
    values: countries[0]
  }
)

viewof unite = Inputs.radio(types_unit, {
  label: "Unité à afficher en y :",
  format: x => x.name,
  value: types_unit[1]   
})

```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

country_health_spending = health_spending.filter(
  d => d.country_name === selected_country &&
    d.unit === unite.name
)
```

# Evolution des dépenses de santé

```{ojs}
evolution.legend("color")
evolution  = Plot.line(country_health_spending,
  {
    x: "year",
    y: "value",
    stroke: "expenditure_type"
  }
).plot()
```

# Table
```{ojs}
Inputs.table(country_health_spending)
```
